paite: Nang zaw thuhilhna hoih toh kituak thu gen in.
heading: Sinsak Ding Tuamtuamte

paite: Putekte kidek thei, zahtakhuai, lungsim hoihtak, ginna leh itna leh kuhkalna a diktak hi ding in hanthawn in.
Pitekte leng huchibang in, sianthouna toh kimeh, khohei a zahdan siam ding leh heh hat lou, uain hai lou, thil hoihte zilsakte hi zaw ding in hanthawn in.
Nungak deuhte tuh apasalte uh leh atate uh it ding leh lungsim hoihtak pu a om ding a ahilhtheihna ding un,
Pathian thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in theisiamtak a kithunun thei, beven lou, amau insung kem hiathiat, chingkam leh apasalte thuthu a om ding a athuhilh theihna ding in.
Huai bang in, tangvalte lungsim hoihtak pu ding in hasuan in.
Thil bangkim a thil hoih hih lam a etton ding in kibawl inla; na thugin sinsakna ah diktatna, chihtakna leh,
gensiat vual louh paukamte langsak lechin alehlam a nang hon demte'n nang tungtang thu a thusia gen ding nei lou a azumtheihna ding un.
Sikhate, apute uh sel lou a athuthu a om ding leh bangkim a akipahna ding ua om ding in thuhilh in.
Pathian i hondampa thuhilhna thu bangkim a akilawmsak theihna ding un, khut them nei lou ding, muanhuai a nna hoih tengteng hihlang zaw ding in sinsak in.
Mi tengteng kiang ah hotdamna hon tun in i Pathian hehpihna ahong tungta hi.
heading: Lametna Kipahhuai

paite: Pathian limsaklouhna leh khovel duhgawlna tawpsan in, tulai khovel ah kidek leh diktattak leh Pathian limsak in i om ding uh chih theisak in.
Lametna kipahhuai, i Pathian thupi leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist thupina kilakna ngak in.
Ama'n tatlekna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon tattheihna ding in leh chitel tuam, thil hoih hih a phatuamngai, amah a ding a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in i sik in akipeta hi.
Thuneitak in huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn inla, taihilh in. Kuamah in nang hon musit kei uhen.
